description:
A screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content.


Snow Shot / Snow Shot Mini 1.2.6
更新内容
- 测量与标注更灵活：新增角度测量，距离标注可按校准后的数值修改；文字支持粗体、斜体，标注颜色预设可自定义，水印内容可跨截图保留。
- 公式与表格识别更方便（完整版）：LaTeX 识别结果可预览、编辑；表格和公式识别可选择视觉模型。
- 贴图更好用：可设置贴图阴影，隐藏、恢复贴图窗口，改善窗口大小与内容的匹配。
- 截图更流畅、更省内存：改善选区拖动与显示的流畅度，空闲时减少内存占用；再次截图时，光标显示更稳定。
- 日常操作更稳定：改善序号文字样式、设置修改、长菜单和弹窗关闭，修复更新下载进度显示。
What's new
- More flexible measurement and annotation: measure angles, edit distances by their calibrated value, use bold and italic text, customize color presets, and remember watermark text across captures.
- Easier formula and table recognition (Full edition): preview and edit recognized LaTeX formulas, and choose a vision model for table and formula recognition.
- Better pinned images: customize shadows, hide and restore pinned windows, and get improved sizing around their content.
- Smoother capture, lower idle memory use: smoother selection dragging and display, less memory use while idle, and more consistent cursor display when taking another screenshot.
- Everyday reliability: improved numbered text styles, settings edits, long menus, popup dismissal, and update download progress.
macOS 快速安装 / Install on macOS
需要 macOS 15 或更新版本，在终端执行。/ Requires macOS 15 or later. Copy into Terminal.
Snow Shot
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.2.6_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh
Snow Shot Mini（仅 Apple Silicon / Apple Silicon only）
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.2.6_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh --edition mini
脚本自动选择架构并校验安装包；按提示授予屏幕录制和辅助功能权限。GitHub 下载不畅时，将命令中的 https://github.com 替换为 https://gitee.com。/ The script selects your architecture and verifies the package. Grant Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions when prompted. If GitHub is unavailable, replace https://github.com with https://gitee.com.
普通 Windows 电脑选 x64，Windows on Arm 选 ARM64；M 系列 Mac 选 arm64，Intel Mac 选 x86_64。手动安装选择 .exe、-portable.zip 或 .dmg。/ Choose x64 for most Windows PCs, ARM64 for Windows on Arm, arm64 for M-series Macs, or x86_64 for Intel Macs. For manual installation, choose an .exe, -portable.zip, or .dmg.
